name: Button 按钮

semanticTypeCandidates.evidence: Primary action control; the tinted glass button is the signature Liquid Glass element (ambient tint + specular highlight).

representativeVariants.name: Primary tinted glass
representativeVariants.whySelected: The iconic Liquid Glass primary — ambient-tinted fill, specular 1px inner top highlight, rounded rect

representativeVariants.name: Secondary translucent glass
representativeVariants.whySelected: Regular glass material on a control — translucent white fill over backdrop blur, hairline border, reads as iOS27 secondary

representativeVariants.name: Destructive
representativeVariants.whySelected: iOS alert destructive style — red tinted glass for dangerous actions

structurePatterns: active press scales 0.97 with light pulse

usageHints.glassRule: Only key actions get ambient tinting; do not stack glass on glass — elements above a glass layer use plain translucent fills

unknowns: exact tint intensity shifts with wallpaper ambient color; treated as one source of truth via --color-primary
keyInsightSeed: Tinted glass primary with specular highlight and liquid press feedback
